import time
m = int(time.strftime('%m'))
d = int(time.strftime('%d'))
y = int(time.strftime('%Y'))
days = [31, 28, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31]
if y % 4 == 0 and (y % 100 != 0 or y % 400 == 0):
    days[1] = 29
s = 0
for i in range(m - 1):
    s = s + days[i]
print(int(time.strftime('%j')) == s + d)
